validation_scope.notes: Current Codex validation stops at running the install command and inspecting the installed directory shape. Codex Desktop app-session launch, discovery, and /diayn-* runtime invocation are intentionally not attempted and are not claimed.

codex_desktop.target: Package/install alpha target: installed workflow skills must be copied into the expected Codex skills shape with DIAYN-managed dependency skills and routing metadata present. Desktop app-session runtime invocation is outside the current validation scope.

validation_boundary.notes: Do not launch Codex Desktop for this validation scope. The current proof is package shape plus executed project-local and Codex-home install fixtures with directory inspection.

claude_code_cli.target: Alpha target only if installed workflow skills can be invoked through bare /diayn-* and can route to DIAYN-managed dependency skills.

plugin_dir_probe.notes: Claude plugin-dir loading is namespaced. It remains useful as a plugin artifact, but the bare command requirement is satisfied by the project-local package shape instead.

routed_dependency_from_diayn_init.first_stop_condition: The Owner has not confirmed project_slug.

command_sequence_probe.notes: All commands and skills are visible in Claude init payloads and every bare /diayn-* command enters workflow context. The validation short-circuit identity probe is not reliable because project-local slash commands enter native command/skill context and may begin normal workflow startup before echoing the requested identity line.

installed_flow_fixture.notes: The installed-flow fixture installs the Claude project-local package into a clean controlled fixture, verifies 12 commands, 12 workflow skills, the locked dependency payload, clean git baseline, and local E2E. Real /diayn-init, /diayn-plan, /diayn-worktrees, /diayn-backend, /diayn-frontend, /diayn-review-backend, /diayn-review-frontend, /diayn-sync, /diayn-integration, /diayn-html, /diayn-bug, and /diayn-new attempts enter native workflow skill context. The flow creates the minimum scaffold, planning artifacts, authorized backend/frontend worktrees, lane worker worklog/evidence with local E2E evidence, candidate_done without self-approval, same-worktree review logs, document-only sync with no business-code merge, integration summary and E2E evidence, durable Owner acceptance Markdown plus readable HTML aid, a /diayn-bug no-active-bug side-scenario record, stage closeout, and stage-2 baseline refresh. Workflow errors are empty and command checkpoints are recorded for every public DIAYN command selected in the run.

opencode_cli.target: Deferred unless installed workflow skills can be directly triggered through /diayn-*.
opencode_cli.reason: Local reference projects indicate OpenCode uses a different skills/tool model, not proven bare /diayn-* installed workflow-skill invocation.

full_flow.reason: Claude project-local packaging passes bare-command, direct dependency-skill, DIAYN workflow routed dependency-skill smoke probes, and 12-command workflow-entry probes. A clean installed-flow fixture has now run all 12 public commands from an installed project-local package: /diayn-init -> /diayn-plan -> /diayn-worktrees -> /diayn-backend -> /diayn-frontend -> /diayn-review-backend -> /diayn-review-frontend -> /diayn-sync -> /diayn-integration -> /diayn-html -> /diayn-bug -> /diayn-new. It proves package installation, clean baseline, local E2E, native workflow entry, scaffold creation, planning artifacts, authorized worktree creation, backend/frontend lane execution and review, document-only sync, integration evidence, durable Owner acceptance, no-active-bug side-scenario triage, closeout, next-stage baseline refresh, and per-command fixture checkpoints. Phase 12 side-scenario validation additionally proves non-Git handling, existing-project conflict reports, dirty preflight, not_applicable lane behavior, interrupted recovery, scaffold migration dry-run, dependency substitution policy, privacy/network defaults, and cleanup boundaries. Codex package/install validation now also has a statically validated project-local .codex/skills package shape with 12 workflow skills and 23 DIAYN-managed dependency skills, an executed project-local install fixture that writes the package into .codex/skills shape, an executed Codex-home install fixture that writes the package into CODEX_HOME skills shape, and inspected installed directory evidence. Codex Desktop app-session launch/runtime invocation requires separate runtime evidence and is not claimed. The release claim is therefore complete for Claude project-local plus Codex package/install scope, with a warning that Codex Desktop app-session runtime remains outside the current validation scope.

warnings.issue: Codex package/install scope is validated through install commands and directory inspection, but Codex Desktop app-session discovery, direct /diayn-* invocation, and native dependency-skill invocation require separate runtime evidence before they can be claimed.
The Claude plugin-dir artifact exposes namespaced commands. Use the project-local package when the user-facing requirement is bare /diayn-*.

Dependency routing evidence is a direct dependency-skill probe plus representative routed /diayn-init -> idea-refine probe. The Phase 12 installed-flow and side-scenario gates validate the installed DIAYN workflow, but do not exercise every vendored dependency skill in context.
Every bare /diayn-* command enters workflow context, but the validation short-circuit argument is not reliable evidence because normal workflow startup may run before the requested identity echo.
